name: Homes.co.nz
description: A New Zealand property information website using council records and selected open data.
story: Homes.co.nz combines property data obtained from local councils with open data. A New Zealand Government showcase identifies address and property-boundary data from the LINZ Data Service, alongside school-enrolment-zone data from the Ministry of Education. The site therefore draws on LINZ data as one part of a wider property-information service.
